description: Released recording-transfer sealer wheels that may be installed on rig hosts. One entry per version; adding a version is a reviewed commit. install_recording_transfer.sh refuses any wheel whose sha256 differs from its entry. New releases (3.1.0 onwards) come from JohnsonLabJanelia/pancake-plate (private); the package name stays citrus-recording-transfer.

releases.notes: Last release built from the Citrus repository; kept installed as the rollback for the 3.1.0 cutover (approved 2026-10-10). Matches Orange's pin.

also_built_by.note: History and tags carried over from Citrus; this tag rebuilds the same wheel byte-identically (sha256 eb12e5df...), as reported by the citrus session on 2026-10-10. The installer trusts the sha256, not the repo.

source.release_assets: wheel + SHA256SUMS, published 2026-10-11 on Jeremy's approval; downloaded asset verified against the sha256 above

releases.notes: First release from pancake-plate (merge of PR #1): admits Citrus stimulus videos declared in a Citrus receipt v2. Reproducible build (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH = tag commit time). Wheel sha256 and tag->commit verified by pancakebatter on 2026-10-10 (sha256sum; GitHub API). 3.0.0 stays installed as the rollback until Orange re-pins.
